newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Rate on 91-day Bahrain t-bills flat at 5.50 pct.
newsitem.headline: Rate on 91-day Bahrain t-bills flat at 5.50 pct.

text.p: The average yield at this week's tender for ten million dinars of 91-day Bahrain treasury bills was steady at 5.50 percent, unchanged from a week ago, a spokesman for the Bahrain Monetary Agency said on Monday.
The average price edged down to 98.628 from 98.629 and the minimum price accepted was 98.614.
Banks submitted bids for 29.4 million dinars worth of bills, down from 31.7 million dinars the previous week.
The bills, maturing on June 18, were offered on Monday and will be issued on Wednesday.
